Small-size words (tiny) and quality adjectives (red, old, lemon) stay weak, as do time durations ('20 minutes'). Ordinary prose with no magnitude expression stays near 0 on every token, including the first, and a scattering of name-initial tokens (' B'rixham, ' F'ife) are acknowledged leftovers.
